name: Apep
source:
The protagonist escapes reality and delves into a fantasy world within his mind.
As he meets and spends time with girls who seem to symbolize his own personality, will he choose to grow or to fall into depravity?
Watching these girls begin to warp as time passes, how will you choose to live?
